notes.title: When They Arrived v0.8.1 Halloween.

tags.feature: - Added Halloween atmosphere;
- Added new lighting;
- Added a new system for changing the time of day, new, more realistic clouds, sounds of the environment, rain, snow, thunder and thunder;

tags.bug: - fixed all the errors with the time in the game, with a wristwatch;
- fixed some errors in the movement of the character;
- in some places, lamps, chandeliers and lamps were added, which turned dark places into well-lit ones;
- Fixed many different bugs;

notes.title: WHEN THEY ARRIVED v 0.8.

tags.feature: - Added a new game mode: "Farm Defense".
- Added new crafting recipes;
- Added new traps;
- The game world is improved, added more loot;
- in the process - arrangement of the settlement Brightwood (new buildings are added, filled with loot, etc.);

tags.bug: - fixed bugs in the sound settings, the sound in the game has become more balanced;

tags.feature: - Added Spanish localization;
- added more places where you can find shelter, sleep, warm up and find provisions;

tags.bug: - Fixed many flaws in the menu sections (the buttons overlapped each other);

tags.feature: - Now some windows are closed when you press Esc;

tags.bug: - fixed bugs with doors, now almost all doors in the game can be opened / closed;

tags.feature: - the aliens are being finalized, soon they will be added weapons that can be used by the player;
- Work is underway on the ability to create various shields and body armor;
- new traps are being developed, soon will be added: crossbow-machine gun, falling wall with spikes and others;

tags.bug: - fixed clock bug, time is displayed correctly;
- fixed bugs in the sleep panel;

tags.balance_change: - alcohol now raises the level of health, and raises thirst;

tags.bug: - fixed bugs with bandages, some buildings, traps and other objects (earlier, after use, they were not removed from the inventory);

notes.title: When They Arrived v0.73.

tags.feature: - added hours, showing the time in the game;
- Added the ability to build and destroy a variety of buildings;
- added a map of the terrain, you need to find all of its fragments, so that it is displayed in full;
- added a new system for saving and loading loot items and your buildings (now all the changes you made to the game will be saved by 100%);

tags.bug: - fixed bugs with endless meat and bonfire;

tags.balance_change: - The sound is corrected, something became louder, something is quieter;

tags.feature: - Added new tips;

tags.bug: - fixed some errors in the plot, and some syntax errors;

tags.feature: - added new crafting recipes;
- Added more places where the protagonist can sleep;

tags.bug: - The sleep system is fixed;

tags.feature: - added several new loot items.

notes.title: When They Arrived v0.72.

tags.feature: - Added new tips;
- Improved system of saving and loading the game;
- extraction of ores is added;
- A new inventory was added;
- added a compass and a map;
- a new system of crafting and recipes;
- improved suspension and lighting of the ATV lantern;
- Improved AI UFO, changed the appearance of UFOs;
- Development of a small village has begun, new residential buildings have been added;
- Added new types of weapons;
- Now you can get wood in two ways - to cut a tree with an ax, saw a tree in a sawmill;

tags.bug: - Fixed bugs in the removal of ammunition;

notes.title: Information about the update 0.72.
notes.content:
We are experiencing a delay with the update of 0.72. The reason for this was many problems with new inventory, craft and spawn loot. Since we want to issue in the update less adequate inventory and crafting - we decided to wait a little with the update. The delay will be just a couple of days.
The update will add new features and clarify some old points.

tags.feature: - The update will add new features and clarify some old points.

notes.title: When They Arrived v0.71.

tags.bug: - fixed some errors in the story;

tags.feature: - improved lighting, rays from the sun;
- the length of the day is doubled;

tags.bug: - Fixed a bright night sky;

tags.feature: - Now the game supports any resolution that supports your monitor and video card;
- selection of notes and newspapers is arranged;

tags.balance_change: - Improved balancing of the ATV, the engine stalls and does not start when the gasoline ends;

tags.bug: - earlier it was impossible to kill aliens and wild boars - the problem is fixed;

tags.balance_change: - the volume of the ATV, rifles, and mutants - became quieter;

tags.feature: - Anabel doll was added, and some paranormal phenomena associated with it;
- changed the appearance and functionality of the hints, now they do not interfere with the play;

tags.bug: - fixed a bug in the sleep panel (you could not sleep more than 1 hour);

tags.balance_change: - there will be more mutants and it will be more difficult to kill them;

tags.feature: - the opportunity to kindle a fire in the house is added;

tags.balance_change: - thirst, hunger and temperature of the environment are balanced;
- added a slider to the generator and a balanced burning of gasoline;

tags.feature: - new sounds of the environment, night and day;
- added a sight-pointer to the center of the screen;
